decision: Single-Page Application (SPA) with in-page anchor navigation and interactive modal
rationale: For a local Swedish auto repair workshop with 4 core services, a cohesive, fast-loading single page converts significantly better on mobile than multi-page navigation. It prevents fragmented bounce rates.

decision: Transparent direct mailto dispatch with full form prefilling and direct call fallback (Option A)
rationale: No server backend exists. Simulated submissions destroy client trust. Generating a prefilled mailto directly addressed to info@mekian.com is honest, works on all devices, and creates immediate utility.

decision: Regnr field serves as a prefill vehicle identifier for the contact inquiry, NOT an automatic pricing engine
rationale: Avoids deceptive promises of instant pricing calculations while giving car owners a convenient, familiar way to specify their car.

decision: Scandinavian automotive workshop palette: slate/charcoal (#0A0E17, #111827), precision blue (#0284C7), and subtle warm amber (#F59E0B)
rationale: Replaces generic crypto/fintech neon glows with a grounded, practical, trustworthy aesthetic reflecting a real physical garage in Täby.

decision: Calm, understated, factual Swedish business copy
rationale: Removes AI buzzwords and legal absolutes ('Nybilsgarantin gäller alltid', '100%'). Follows Swedish business standards.

decision: Persistent bottom action bar on mobile viewports (<640px) with direct call and book modal triggers
rationale: Over 70% of urgent auto repair visitors are on mobile phones; one-thumb calling access maximizes inbound leads.
